raw_text: Satellite imagery from Planet Labs dated March 11 shows new crated aircraft at Pakistan Aeronautical Complex, Kamra. Configuration consistent with JF-17 Block 3 fuselage sections. Delivery flight from Chengdu likely via Karakoram corridor. This matches PAF procurement timeline for AESA-equipped variants.
